description: Inspection record of one establishment by city and id (from restaurant_inspection_search), or by city and name: the latest inspection with every violation cited (NYC critical flags, Chicago inspector comments, Boston violation level * to *** and whether it was corrected), the current NYC letter grade, past inspections with scores or results, and how many inspections in the last 3 years failed or ended in a closure. Austin publishes scores only.

address.description: Street words to pick one location of a chain when searching by name.

city.description: New York City (or Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island), Chicago, Austin or Boston (or a Boston neighborhood).

id.description: Establishment id from restaurant_inspection_search: NYC CAMIS, Chicago license number, Austin facility id or Boston license number.

inspections.description: How many past inspections to return. Default 8.

name.description: Name, used when no id is given; the best match is used and other matches are listed.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code in a covered city.

name: restaurant_inspection_history
title: Restaurant inspection history and violations
